title: CLAUDE.md — eSVD2 (CRAN submission)
text: Paper/Project: eSVD2 R package implementing eSVD-DE, cohort-wide differential-expression method single-cell RNA-seq. package published (Lin, Qiu & Roeder, BMC Bioinformatics 2024, 25:113, doi:10.1186/s12859-024-05724-7) currently installs GitHub . Authors: Kevin Z. Lin (aut, cre — method, R/C++ code, analyses), Yixuan Qiu (R/C++ code, especially src/ optimization backend), Kathryn Roeder (method). Current goal (2026-08-27): convert repository formal R package suitable CRAN submission. emphasis correctness first (hidden failure modes, silent NaN/Inf, untested code paths, dependency policy), performance. working document driving effort additional_context/CRAN_READINESS.md — read touching package structure, DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, src/, tests/. companion additional_context/UNIT_TEST_PLAN.md, proposed test suite (~200 tests, ID explicit oracle); read writing test regenerating anything tests/assets/. proposal awaiting review, agreed plan. Method one paragraph (session need re-read paper): eSVD-DE models cells × genes count matrix hierarchically A_ji | λ_ji ~ Poisson(ℓ_ji · λ_ji) λ_ji ~ Gamma(mean = μ_ji, var = γ_j·μ_ji), μ_ji = exp(Y_j·ᵀ X_i· + Z_j,(cc)·C_i,(cc)) low-rank “predictable” expression ℓ_ji = exp(Z_j,-(cc)ᵀ C_i,-(cc)) covariate-adjusted sequencing depth. pipeline : format_covariates → initialize_esvd (glmnet Poisson ridge per gene, SVD log1p() − ZᵀC) → opt_esvd (alternating constrained Newton C++, two phases: case–control coefficient held fixed, freed) → reparameterization_esvd_covariates (orthogonalize X C, , identifiability) → estimate_nuisance (per-gene overdispersion via gamma_rate / log_gamma_rate C++) → compute_posterior (Gamma–Poisson posterior mean variance per cell × gene) → compute_test_statistic (average posteriors within individual, summarize case control groups Gaussian mixtures, Welch two-sample statistic) → compute_pvalue (Welch df → t--z transform → locfdr empirical null → BH). compute_test_per_gene memory-lean alternative fuses last three steps per-gene loop.
